messages: maya (Design): Quick sync — I'm testing a compact left nav grouping Models + Deployments under one cluster. Question: label it 'Workloads' or 'Workspaces'? sam (Frontend): 'Workloads' is explicit but techy; 'Workspaces' friendlier. Either works, but breadcrumbs must use the same token: e.g., Workloads / Models / . jonah (PM): Also need canonical deep links. Two ideas: `/w/:org/workloads/:type/:id` vs `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId`. Which maps easier to the router? sam (Frontend): Lean `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId`. Simpler route matchers and fallback rules: missing modelId -> list view; bad workspace -> redirect to `/workspace` with toast. kevin (A11y): A11y notes: add `aria-current` to last crumb; separators should be `aria-hidden`. Skiplink copy: "Skip to main navigation" is clearer. When nav collapses, ensure skip target points to first interactive nav item. maya (Design): For collapsed groups, can we switch from '+' to a chevron with accessible label? e.g., Workloads ▸ + tooltip on hover reading 'Expand'. sam (Frontend): We'll make full row clickable for 44px touch, with a button including `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Pseudocode: "". jonah (PM): Support requested shareable permalink should preserve UI state if needed. Use `?view=compact` rather than a cookie so links behave consistently. kevin (A11y): If view toggles via query param, announce change in an `aria-live` region (polite) like "Navigation collapsed" so screen reader users understand the change. maya (Design): Truncation: ellipsize long workspace names visually and provide full name in `aria-label` rather than relying on `title`. sam (Frontend): Agreed — tooltips are poor on touch. Example: "Very Long N...". Also add a visually-hidden full copy inside crumb popover for keyboard users. kevin (A11y): After breadcrumb navigation, set focus to the main content header (tabindex=-1) to preserve logical flow. Avoid jumping to top-of-page. maya (Design): Layout poll: icons-only compact nav for density vs icons+mini-label for discoverability. Quick reactions: :thumbsup: = icons-only, :raised_hand: = icons+label. jonah (PM): I'll run a hallway test tomorrow. For staging/dev, keep both modes toggleable via local storage and `?navMode=compact` so we can demo. Router should normalize paths and preserve `view` and `navMode`. sam (Frontend): Noted — we'll implement route normalization and optional param passthrough in matcher. maya (Design): Small copy: breadcrumb separator uses › now. Mark it `aria-hidden` and pick a thinner glyph visually. Also ensure contrast meets AA thresholds. navbot (deploy-bot): FYI branch `nav-compact-experiments` deployed to staging at `staging.redwood.internal/nav-test` (build 2026.03.22-9). maya (Design): Action items: 1) validate skiplink target, 2) check aria-live announcements, 3) verify breadcrumb contrast, 4) test permalinks preserve view. Can everyone try staging and drop quick notes? sam (Frontend): Will test and post small fixes here. jonah (PM): I'll collect results and decide on label by EOD Friday unless strong objections. kevin (A11y): I'll run a screen reader pass and upload notes to the thread. maya (Design): Thanks team — if no objections we'll move forward with 'Workloads' and the a11y copy fixes. :sparkles:
